findings.title: Retry cleanup deletes non-SMS workflow reminders
findings.body: The `retryCount > 1` arm of this `OR` is not constrained to `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS`. This cron endpoint will therefore permanently delete any email or WhatsApp `WorkflowReminder` whose retry count exceeds one, even though this job only processes SMS reminders. Scope the retry cleanup to unscheduled SMS reminders so retry state for other delivery methods cannot cause their reminders to be removed.

findings.title: Retry increments can be lost when cron executions overlap
findings.body: The retry count is calculated from the value read by `findMany` and then written as `reminder.retryCount + 1`. If two cron invocations process the same unscheduled reminder concurrently, both can read (for example) zero and both write one. The failed reminder then gets more than the intended two attempts, and concurrent scheduling attempts can continue. Use a database-side atomic increment (and ideally condition it on the reminder still being unscheduled) rather than writing a stale read value.
